Local changes for vrclib (marked "vrclib patch"):
- background colour for the window and the web view before the first paint
- WM_DPICHANGED handling, small icon, arrow cursor, centring on the work area
- no log.Fatal when WebView2 cannot start: the window is destroyed and New returns nil
- MoveHook: called when the window moves, for a second web view inside it
